parameters.toolDescription:
Place a new order. Required params:
- customer_name: customer's full name
- items: a JSON STRING representing an array of items, e.g. [{"name":"iPhone case","qty":2,"price":25.00}]
- notes: delivery address, payment method, or other notes (can be empty)
The business_id and customer_phone are filled automatically.

parameters.name: items
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('items', 'JSON array string of order items, each with name, qty, price. Example: [{"name":"iPhone case","qty":2,"price":25.00}]', 'string') }}

parameters.name: notes
parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('notes', 'Delivery address, payment method, or other notes', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: Look up the status of one of THIS customer's own orders. Required param: order_id (numeric ID of the order). If it says the order was not found, tell the customer you cannot find an order with that number on their account.

Escalate this conversation to a human operator. Use when you cannot help, the customer is frustrated, or they explicitly ask for a human. Required params:
- reason: short reason for escalation
- customer_name: customer's name if known (can be empty)
The business_id, customer_phone, and last_message are filled automatically.

Book a new appointment for the customer. ALWAYS call check_availability for that date first and only book a time it lists as free. Required params:
- customer_name: customer's full name
- scheduled_at: LOCAL business time in ISO 8601 WITHOUT a timezone suffix, e.g. 2026-05-15T15:00:00
- notes: service requested or extra info (can be empty)
The business_id and customer_phone are filled automatically. If the result says slot_unavailable, do NOT confirm the booking: tell the customer why and offer the suggested_slots.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.business_id, customer_phone: $('Build Prompt').first().json.customer_phone, session_id: $('Resolve Session').first().json.session.id, role: "user", message: $('Parse Payload').first().json.message_text }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.business_id, customer_phone: $('Build Prompt').first().json.customer_phone, session_id: $('Resolve Session').first().json.session.id, role: "assistant", message: $('Clean Reply').first().json.reply }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.business_id, to: $('Build Prompt').first().json.customer_phone, message: $('Clean Reply').first().json.reply }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Check which appointment times are free on a given date. Required param: date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns free_ranges (local HH:MM-HH:MM windows) and free_slots (exact start times; use them only to check a specific time, never list them to the customer), or open=false with next_available days when closed or full. Use it before booking and whenever the customer asks about availability.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Get Business ID').first().json.business_id, to: $('Parse Payload').first().json.user_phone, message: $('Resolve Session').first().json.limit_message }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: List THIS customer's upcoming appointments (id, local time, status). No params. Use it first whenever the customer wants to cancel, move or ask about their booking. If the list is empty, tell them they have no upcoming appointments.

IMPORTANT: only call this after the customer has explicitly confirmed in a previous message. Cancel one of the customer's upcoming appointments. First call list_my_appointments and confirm with the customer WHICH one. Required param: appointment_id (number). Optional: reason. If the result says too_late or not_changeable, do NOT claim it was cancelled - relay the message and suggest contacting the business. Do NOT use this to change the time of an appointment; use reschedule_appointment for that.

IMPORTANT: only call this after the customer has explicitly confirmed in a previous message. Move one of the customer's upcoming appointments to a new time. First call list_my_appointments to find the id, and check_availability for the new date; only move to a time it lists as free. Required params: appointment_id (number), scheduled_at (LOCAL business time, ISO 8601 WITHOUT timezone suffix, e.g. 2026-05-15T15:00:00). If the result says slot_unavailable, too_late or not_changeable, do NOT confirm the move: relay the message and offer suggested_slots if given.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.business_id, customer_phone: $('Build Prompt').first().json.customer_phone, message: $('Parse Payload').first().json.message_text, error: String(($json.error && $json.error.message) || $json.error || '').slice(0, 400) }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ business_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.business_id, to: $('Build Prompt').first().json.customer_phone, message: $json.message }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ output: $('Report Agent Failure').first().json.message, fallback: true }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: IMPORTANT: only call this after the customer has explicitly confirmed in a previous message. Cancel one of the customer's own orders by order number. Confirm with the customer first. Required param: order_id (number, the order number given when it was placed). Optional: reason. Works only while the order is pending or confirmed; if the result says not_cancellable or not found, do NOT claim it was cancelled - relay the message and offer to pass it to the team.

IMPORTANT: only call this after the customer has explicitly confirmed the new order contents in a previous message. Change the items of one of the customer's own orders. Required params: order_id (number); items: the COMPLETE new list as a JSON STRING, e.g. [{"name":"ERP system","qty":2,"price":200}] (not just the change); notes (optional). Works only while the order is pending; if the result says not_editable or not found, do NOT claim it was changed - relay the message.

parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('items', 'COMPLETE new list of order items as a JSON array string, each with name, qty, price. Example: [{"name":"iPhone case","qty":2,"price":25.00}]', 'string') }}

parameters.value: ={{ $fromAI('notes', 'New delivery address or notes, only if the customer changed them (otherwise leave empty)', 'string') }}

parameters.toolDescription: List THIS customer's recent orders (id, status, items, notes, can_edit, can_cancel). No params. Use it first whenever the customer wants to cancel, change or ask about an order, especially if they do not know the order number. If the list is empty, tell them they have no orders.

Call this when the customer says they do not want any more follow-up or promotional messages from the business (for example: stop messaging me, don't contact me again, unsubscribe, وقف الرسائل). No params. It does NOT affect reminders for their own bookings. After it succeeds, confirm briefly that they will not receive follow-up messages anymore.
